parameters.query: WITH _ts AS (SELECT set_config('app.current_tenant', COALESCE(resolve_tenant_from_project($1::uuid)::text, ''), false) AS s) SELECT q.* FROM (SELECT p.id, p.name as project_name, p.project_type, p.budget_target, p.location_address, p.location_city, p.location_province, p.property_type, p.property_area_m2, c.name as client_name, c.email as client_email, (SELECT row_to_json(b.*) FROM briefings b WHERE b.project_id = p.id AND b.status = 'approved' ORDER BY b.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) as briefing, (SELECT row_to_json(d.*) FROM design_options d WHERE d.project_id = p.id AND d.is_selected = true LIMIT 1) as design_option, (SELECT row_to_json(ce.*) FROM cost_estimates ce WHERE ce.project_id = p.id ORDER BY ce.version DESC LIMIT 1) as cost_estimate, (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('trade_type', tr.trade_type, 'scope_description', tr.scope_description) ORDER BY tr.trade_type) FROM trade_requests tr WHERE tr.project_id = p.id AND tr.status = 'prepared') as trade_assignments, (SELECT row_to_json(pp.*) FROM project_plans pp WHERE pp.project_id = p.id ORDER BY pp.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) as project_plan FROM projects p JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id WHERE p.id = $1::uuid) q, _ts
SELECT content, model_recommended, temperature FROM agent_prompts WHERE agent_name = 'agent_safety_plan' AND prompt_type = 'system' AND is_active = true LIMIT 1
INSERT INTO agent_executions (project_id, agent_name, status, started_at) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_safety_plan', 'running', NOW()) RETURNING id
INSERT INTO safety_plans (project_id, version, document_type, content_json, status, execution_id, exec_status) VALUES ($1::uuid, 1, $2, $3::jsonb, 'draft', $4::uuid, 'draft') RETURNING id
UPDATE safety_plans SET google_doc_id = $1, google_doc_url = $2, exec_status = 'confirmed' WHERE id = $3::uuid RETURNING id, google_doc_url
